input.quote: Vendor shall not revoke or suspend a licence except during a material uncured payment or use breach affecting the licensed item, after notice and a reasonable opportunity to cure.
input.rationale: Section 13.1 grants a worldwide, non-exclusive subscription right to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf (with Authorized Users permitted), so affiliates and contractors are expressly covered without any notice condition. Section 13.2 gives Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, fully paid licence to delivered or embedded Vendor Technology, and Section 14.3 confirms that licence extends to Vendor Technology needed to use a Deliverable. Section 13.3 permits transfer of licence rights to an Affiliate or successor in connection with an assignment permitted by Section 24 (which allows assignment to a successor in an M&A transaction without consent) and limits revocation or suspension to a material uncured payment or use breach after notice and a cure opportunity. No at-will revocation right remains anywhere in the document, and Section 24.4 bars Vendor from suspending on a Customer change of control. This meets the preferred position in full, so no redline is warranted.
